method: Each claim checked against the retrieved text of the ASHM anogenital warts page. Regimens, cycle structures and durations compared character by character.

claims.claim: Treatment of anogenital warts is cosmetic rather than curative
claims.source_text: Treatment is cosmetic rather than curative.

claims.claim: The auditable outcome is that 100% of patients diagnosed with genital warts are provided with information
claims.source_text: 100% of patients diagnosed with genital warts are provided with information.

claims.claim: The long latent period, just as with herpes, means that the presence of warts in only one partner does not necessarily imply recent infidelity
claims.source_text: The long latent period, just as with herpes, means that the presence of warts in only one partner does not necessarily imply recent infidelity.

claims.claim: Warty growths cause little discomfort and are sometimes itchy, but psychological distress is often significant
claims.source_text: Warty growths in and around anogenital skin or mouth. Little discomfort (sometimes itchy) but often psychological distress is significant

claims.claim: Diagnosis is usually based on visual appearance
claims.source_text: Diagnosis is usually based on visual appearance.

claims.claim: HPV PCR testing is not used to diagnose anogenital warts
claims.source_text: HPV PCR testing is not used to diagnose Anogenital warts.

claims.claim: Consider other potential causes such as syphilis presenting as condylomata lata
claims.source_text: Consider other potential causes (e.g. syphilis presenting as condylomata lata).

claims.claim: Most anogenital warts are caused by HPV types 6 and 11 and infection results in type-specific protection
claims.source_text: Most anogenital warts are caused by HPV types 6 and 11 and infection results in type-specific protection.

claims.claim: Most HPV infections are asymptomatic
claims.source_text: Most HPV infections are asymptomatic.

claims.claim: HPV transmission is from direct skin-to-skin contact with apparent or subclinical lesions and contact with genital secretions, with micro-abrasions in the recipient's skin allowing viral access to the basal cells of the epithelium
claims.source_text: Human papillomavirus (HPV) transmission is from direct skin-to-skin contact with apparent or subclinical lesions and contact with genital secretions. Micro-abrasions in the recipient's skin allow viral access to the basal cells of the epithelium.

claims.claim: Atypical lesions, lesions with variable pigmentation or raised plaque-like lesions should be biopsied to exclude pre-cancerous change, especially in patients who are immunosuppressed or have HIV
claims.source_text: Atypical lesions, lesions with variable pigmentation or raised plaque-like lesions should be biopsied to exclude pre-cancerous change especially in patients who are immunosuppressed or have human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)

claims.claim: Consider referral and biopsy of atypical lesions or new lesions in elderly people to test for malignancy
claims.source_text: Consider referral and biopsy of atypical lesions or new lesions in elderly people (to test for malignancy).

claims.claim: Malignancy of the penis, anus, oropharynx, vulva, vagina and cervix is possible with oncogenic HPV genotypes
claims.source_text: Malignancy (penile, anal, oropharynx) is possible with oncogenic HPV genotypes. Malignancy (vulvar, vaginal, cervical, anal, oropharynx) is possible with oncogenic HPV genotypes.

claims.claim: Cervical lesions noted on vaginal examination should have cervical screening conducted as per national guidelines
claims.source_text: Cervical lesions noted on vaginal examination should have cervical screening conducted as per national guidelines

claims.claim: Recommended treatment is patient-applied podophyllotoxin paint topically twice a day for 3 days then 4 days off, repeated weekly for 4-6 cycles until resolution
claims.source_text: Patient applied podophyllotoxin paint topically applied, twice a day for 3 days, then 4 days off, repeated weekly for 4-6 cycles until resolution.

claims.claim: Alternatively patient-applied imiquimod 5% cream topically 3 times per week at bedtime, washed off after 6-10 hours, until resolution up to 16 weeks
claims.source_text: Patient applied imiquimod 5% cream topically, 3 times per week at bedtime (wash after 6-10 hours) until resolution (up to 16 weeks).

claims.claim: The alternative is clinician-initiated cryotherapy weekly, and rarely excision under local anaesthetic or ablative therapy under general anaesthetic with specialist advice
claims.source_text: Clinician initiated cryotherapy weekly. (Rarely may need excision under local anaesthetic or ablative therapy under general anaesthetic. Seek specialist advice.)

claims.claim: Meatal warts are treated with cryotherapy
claims.source_text: Meatal warts: treat with cryotherapy

claims.claim: Intra-anal warts are treated with cryotherapy or referred for surgical management
claims.source_text: Intra-anal warts: treat with cryotherapy or refer for surgical management

claims.claim: Cervical warts require initial cervical cytology and referral to a gynaecologist for consideration of colposcopy, biopsy and treatment as indicated
claims.source_text: Cervical warts: initial cervical cytology and refer to gynaecologist for consideration of colposcopy, biopsy and treatment as indicated.

claims.claim: In HIV infection genital warts can have a poor response to treatment, may require longer cycles of treatment and are more likely to recur
claims.source_text: HIV infection: genital warts can have a poor response to treatment and may require longer cycles of treatment and are more likely to recur.

claims.claim: Persistent intra-anal lesions in people living with HIV should be considered for surgical excision and HPV DNA typing to inform follow-up
claims.source_text: Persistent intra-anal lesions in people living with HIV should be considered for surgical excision and HPV DNA typing to inform follow-up.

claims.claim: Complicated or disseminated infection should be considered for referral for laser or diathermy
claims.source_text: Complicated or disseminated infection | Consider referral for laser or diathermy.

claims.claim: If warts are in the pubic region, avoid shaving or waxing as this may facilitate local spread by autoinoculation of HPV into areas of microtrauma
claims.source_text: If warts are in the pubic region avoid shaving or waxing as this may facilitate local spread by autoinoculation of HPV into areas of microtrauma.

claims.claim: Offer HPV vaccination if not already vaccinated, noting that HPV vaccination is not a therapeutic vaccine but may protect from future acquisition of other HPV types
claims.source_text: Offer HPV vaccination if not already vaccinated. Note that HPV vaccination is not a therapeutic vaccine but may protect people from future acquisition of other HPV types.

claims.claim: Genital warts is not a notifiable condition
claims.source_text: Genital warts is not a notifiable condition.

claims.claim: Warts can grow rapidly in pregnancy and can be treated during pregnancy with cryotherapy or diathermy
claims.source_text: Warts can grow rapidly in pregnancy and can be treated during pregnancy with cryotherapy or diathermy.

claims.claim: In pregnancy cryotherapy can have a poor response and lesions often resolve spontaneously postnatally when immune function returns to normal following delivery
claims.source_text: Pregnancy | Cryotherapy can have a poor response. Lesions often resolve spontaneously postnatally when immune function returns to normal following delivery.

claims.claim: Pregnant people can undergo a normal vaginal delivery as the risk of transmission to the baby is extremely low
claims.source_text: Pregnant people can undergo a normal vaginal delivery as the risk of transmission to the baby is extremely low.

claims.claim: Contact tracing is not recommended as the majority of partners have probably acquired the infection subclinically
claims.source_text: Not recommended. The majority of partners have probably acquired the infection subclinically.

claims.claim: Follow-up is not required if symptoms resolve; review if the patient is anxious or the warts are difficult for the patient to visualise
claims.source_text: Not required if symptoms resolve. Review if patient anxious or warts are difficult for patient to visualise.

claims.claim: Test of cure is not applicable and retesting is not required, though other STI testing should be considered if not undertaken at first presentation or post the window period
claims.source_text: Test of cure. Not applicable. Retesting. Not required. Consider testing for other STIs, if not undertaken at first presentation, or retesting post the window period.

claims.claim: Urethral lesions can cause a distorted urinary stream or bleeding, and anal lesions can cause perianal itch and rectal bleeding after passage of stools
claims.source_text: Distorted urinary stream or bleeding with urethral lesions. Perianal itch. Rectal bleeding after passage of stools with anal lesions

claims.claim: Anogenital warts are caused by human papillomavirus
claims.source_text: Human papillomavirus
